platformName.title: Platform name
platformName.description: Platform name in English and Chinese.

board.title: Board
board.description: Board name in Chinese: 抖音热榜, 百度热搜, 头条热榜 or B站热搜.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position on the board (1 = top). Pinned editorial items are not included.

title.title: Keyword / headline
title.description: The trending keyword or headline as shown (Chinese).
title.example: 英雄联盟S16瑞士轮首日赛程

hotValue.title: Hot value
hotValue.description: The platform's heat score (热度). Scales differ between platforms.

label.title: Label
label.description: Badge as shown: 新, 热, 爆, 首发, 独家, 辟谣, ... null when none.

labelEn.title: Label (English)
labelEn.description: The badge in English: new, hot, explosive, first release, exclusive, debunk, ...

url.title: URL
url.description: The keyword's search or topic page on the platform.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short summary of the topic (Baidu only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Topic categories in English (Toutiao only), e.g. military, finance, international.

videoCount.title: Video count
videoCount.description: Videos about the topic (Douyin, when the douyin.com board is used).

eventTime.title: Event time
eventTime.description: When the topic started trending, ISO 8601 (Douyin, when the douyin.com board is used).
